description: This Java class implements the strategy for handling 'ModifyThingDefinition' commands within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages creating or modifying ThingDefinitions, generating appropriate events and responses, and handling entity tags for concurrency control.

classes.name: ModifyThingDefinitionStrategy
classes.description: Implements handling of ModifyThingDefinition commands, creating or updating ThingDefinitions, and generating corresponding events.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the command by either modifying an existing ThingDefinition or creating a new one based on the presence of the definition in the node.

methods.name: extractDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the ThingDefinition from the given Thing, throwing if not present.

methods.name: getModifyResult
methods.description: Creates a result indicating the modification of an existing ThingDefinition, including event and response construction.

methods.name: getCreateResult
methods.description: Creates a result indicating the creation of a new ThingDefinition, including event and response construction.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous version of the Thing, if available.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag for the new entity based on the command's definition.
